bullets: Added the L2 v0 ranker shadow-decision metrics to the first-party decision log so ranker evidence survives sanitization while campaign identifiers are dropped.
Added a new analytics event tracking which product tab a home hero visitor picks when committing to a product.
Added a Desktop surface to the onboarding questionnaire submission options and a shared form logic module used by both the Web form and the Desktop app.
Updated the steering drain hook to accept structured messages with images, so hosts can inject image-bearing messages into a running turn without aborting the run.
Updated BYOK model compaction to respect each model's output token cap, clamping summarizer requests and rejecting truncated summarization handoffs.
Changed the Freebuff model catalog so Muse Spark 1.3 is the offered Contributor row taking 1.2's slot, while 1.2 is now paid-only and marked superseded by 1.3.
Added start and end hooks around compaction passes in the SDK and agent runtime so hosts can bracket a compaction pass with start and end events.
Added a streak status line to the CLI landing screen and chat header showing whether today's Freebucks bonus has landed and when the next streak day starts.
Added an ending-soon deal badge to the GLM 5.3 Flash model row displaying the Sep 30 deal end and 15 per hour price change.
